tools.name: tsipam-calc-aggregate
tools.description: Summarize supplied or reserved CIDRs into their minimal covering set.

cidr.description: CIDR prefix to aggregate; repeat for each one (instead of [cidr...])

dry-run.description: report what a registry write would do and change nothing

format.description: output format: human|json (default: AGENT_MODE, else human on a terminal and json otherwise)

from-registry.description: aggregate subnet-pool reservations instead of positional CIDRs

idempotency-key.description: opaque key echoed in meta.idempotency_key; it is not stored

sanitize.description: output sanitization level: off|identity|strict (a non-off TAILSCALE_SANITIZE value overrides this flag)

strict.description: escalate warnings to a failure; no command emits a warning today

tailnet.description: routing/storage key for the registry (default: $TAILSCALE_TAILNET, or "local")

yes.description: approve a release without a prompt
